method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the rules in one module, the dates in another, the questions in two seat modules importing them; one regulative rule (s 27(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Wills Act 2000 (NT), Act No. 59, 2000, reprint REPW007 as in force at 1 January 2022, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Wills-Act-2000-NT-current-reprint-REPW007.txt (text sha256 e67f2236631b1596c664d0ac314fe46f38d92c294b4a780710919c9df3453213), converted from the register's Word reprint retrieved 2026-11-06

seats: the will-maker (testator): the individual making, changing, revoking or depositing a will in the Northern Territory, including a minor and a person whose will was made by Court order (wills-seat.l4)

the person with an interest in a deceased person's will: a beneficiary, the surviving spouse, a child or other relative, a person entitled on intestacy, a creditor, the executor seeking the will, and the relative applying for a Court-authorised will for someone without capacity (wills-seat-family.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run wills-dates.l4 ; l4 run wills-rules.l4 ; l4 run wills-seat.l4 ; l4 run wills-seat-family.l4 ; l4 run wills-cases.l4 ; l4 run wills-cases-family.l4
checks.result: 195 assertions written, 195 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Nearly the whole Act from the individual's side.
